run_yelp_review_full_preprocessing: run the YelpReviewFull dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_yelp_review_full_dataset: create a YelpReviewFull instance to load and preprocess the Yelp review full dataset from HuggingFace
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of text and label tuples with newline replacements
get_train_test_lines: get train and test line splits from the Yelp review full dataset using the map function
load_yelp_review_full: load the Yelp review full dataset from HuggingFace datasets using the load_dataset method
